name: Burning Ink
body:
School transmutation; Level bard 4, sorcerer/wizard 4

CASTING

Casting Time 1 round
Components V, S, M (a needle valued at 1 sp, the needle is destroyed by the spell)

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./lvl.)
Target 1 creature possessing tattoos
Duration 1 round/2 levels
Saving Throw Will negates; Spell Resistance Yes

DESCRIPTION

This spell turns mundane tattoo ink embedded in the skin into acid. If a creature has no tattoos or the tattoos of the target are enchanted, the spell will not work, nor does the spell function if the target succeeds on a Will save. If the save fails, the target’s tattoos turn against the wearer, dealing 1d4 points of acid damage per your caster level and lasting for a number of rounds equal to half of your caster level, rounded down. The spell ruins the tattoos of the target creature.
